verses.1: It is the vengeance of Jehovah; it is His way of retribution.
verses.2: The judge who ruled over the land now sits on a throne over the people.
verses.3: Until the day they die, those wicked people will be punished by God. Those wicked people will be brought down to hell.
verses.4: They shall speak in a grand manner; they shall say everything that happens.
verses.5: Your people will be destroyed, and your land will be laid waste.
verses.6: Almanya and Ger Yaharogu will be destroyed, and they will be punished.
verses.7: And they said, “May Jehovah not see him, and may the God of Jacob not understand him.”
verses.8: In midst of storms and among the foolish people, they will be destroyed.
verses.9: He who is deaf cannot hear, and he who is blind cannot see.
verses.10: The ignorant people cannot truly understand what knowledge is.
verses.11: YHWH knows the thoughts of man, for he is all-knowing.
verses.12: Let us learn from the teachings of your Torah.
verses.13: To clear him from the waters of evil, until he is recognized as a good person.
verses.14: For Jehovah will not bring his people and their land back.
verses.15: For justice will be restored through judgment, and after that, all those who are evil will be punished.
verses.16: Who will stand with me against my enemies? Who will be my ally in times of trouble?
verses.17: May the LORD help me, as my soul longs for it.
verses.18: If I say, “Turn my feet towards your mercy, O LORD!” then you will hear me.
verses.19: In many times of sorrow and distress, your words of comfort will heal my soul.
verses.20: May you be like Shem, who was created through great labor.
verses.21: May they praise the soul of the righteous and the pure blood that will inherit them.
verses.22: And Jehovah became my refuge, and my God became my shield.
verses.23: And He shall sit upon them, and in their pain they will cry out to our God.
